notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.1.4

- Older E-Sys (3.30 and newer) works with E-Sys MAX. We still recommend E-Sys 22.06 or newer (best 25.10).
- Old E-Sys that closed by itself at start: E-Sys MAX now starts it on a newer, checked Java 8 and gets that Java for you the first time if your PC has none.
- Fault scan, module info, battery, clear faults, FA backup, FSC and SFA status work on old E-Sys too.
- FDL editor setting names and search on old E-Sys.
- Clearer help for old E-Sys messages (EST file, files saved by a newer E-Sys).
- Small fixes.
